description: Use when the user wants the full text of one published IndustryLens report (after finding its slug via list_reports). Fetch the full body of a published report by slug. Returns the report's structured fields plus content_html (the canonical body) and the report's web URL. pdf_url is a direct link to a generated PDF of the report when one exists (null for older reports or a failed generation) — the IndustryLens website itself doesn't link to it (its own download button re-renders the page via print), but the URL is real and fetchable. Never construct or guess a .pdf URL yourself when pdf_url is null — point the user at the report's web URL instead.
name: get_report
title: Get a full IndustryLens report
